info.title: HTL Kahoot API
info.description: API documentation for the HTL Kahoot application

get.description: Returns the Azure AD OAuth2 authorization URL that the client should redirect to for authentication.
Handles the OAuth2 callback from Azure AD via GET. Exchanges the authorization code for a user and returns a Sanctum token.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The authorization code received from Azure AD

post.description: Handles the OAuth2 callback from Azure AD via POST. Exchanges the authorization code for a user and returns a Sanctum token.

code.description: The authorization code received from Azure AD

post.description: Authenticates an admin user with email and password credentials. Returns a Sanctum token.

get.description: Returns the currently authenticated user with their roles.

post.description: Revokes the current user's authentication token.
Uploads an image or video file and attaches it to the question.

delete.description: Deletes a media file from the question and from storage.

get.description: Returns all available permissions. Admin and superadmin only.

post.description: Creates a new permission. Superadmin only.

delete.description: Deletes a permission and detaches it from all roles. Superadmin only.

get.description: Lists constructive feedback for administrators. Supports filtering by status (open/solved) and pagination.

post.description: Submits a new piece of platform feedback. The local AI model classifies the message as constructive or not before persistence.

get.description: Lists every feedback entry submitted by the authenticated user, newest first.

patch.description: Marks a feedback entry as solved. Admin only.
Reopens a previously resolved feedback entry. Admin only.

get.description: Returns a paginated, filterable list of questions. Accessible by teachers, admins and superadmins.

post.description: Creates a new question and its first version atomically. Accessible by teachers, admins and superadmins.

title.example: What is the capital of France?

get.description: Returns a question with its current version and answer options. Published questions are visible to all authenticated users; unpublished ones require ownership or admin role.

put.description: Creates a new version of the question, preserving all previous versions. Updates current_version_id to the new version.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a question. The owner or admin/superadmin can delete.

post.description: Restores a previously soft-deleted question. Admin and superadmin only.

get.description: Returns all versions of a question ordered by version number. Owner or admin/superadmin only.

patch.description: Toggles the is_published flag of a question. Owner or admin/superadmin only.

post.description: Imports questions from a JSON or Moodle GIFT format file. Creates questions and their first versions atomically. Accessible by teachers, admins and superadmins.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of question pools. Accessible by teachers, admins and superadmins.

post.description: Creates a new question pool. Accessible by teachers, admins and superadmins.

get.description: Returns a question pool with its question count. Shared pools are visible to all authenticated users.

put.description: Updates pool name, description or shared flag. Owner or admin/superadmin only.

delete.description: Deletes a question pool. Owner or admin/superadmin only.

post.description: Attaches one or more questions to the pool. Owner or admin/superadmin only.

delete.summary: Remove a question from a pool
delete.description: Detaches a question from the pool. Owner or admin/superadmin only.

get.description: Returns a paginated, filterable list of quizzes. Accessible by teachers, admins and superadmins.

post.description: Creates a new quiz. Accessible by teachers, admins and superadmins.

get.description: Returns a quiz with its questions and pool. Published quizzes are visible to all authenticated users.

put.description: Updates quiz settings. Owner or admin/superadmin only.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a quiz. Owner or admin/superadmin only.

post.description: Restores a previously soft-deleted quiz. Admin and superadmin only.

patch.description: Toggles the is_published flag of a quiz. Owner or admin/superadmin only.

get.description: Returns all game sessions for a quiz, ordered by most recent first. Includes participant counts and scores.

put.description: Replaces all quiz participants with the given user IDs. Owner or admin/superadmin only.
Replaces all quiz questions atomically. Deletes existing and creates new entries in a single transaction.

post.summary: Add a question to a quiz
post.description: Adds a specific question version to the quiz with sort order and optional overrides.

put.description: Updates sort order, point/time overrides, or weight for a question in the quiz.

delete.summary: Remove a question from a quiz
delete.description: Removes a question entry from the quiz.

get.description: Returns all roles with their assigned permissions. Admin and superadmin only.

post.description: Creates a new role. Superadmin only.

delete.description: Deletes a role and detaches all associated users and permissions. Superadmin only.

post.summary: Assign a role to a user
post.description: Assigns an existing role to a user. Admin and superadmin only.

delete.summary: Remove a role from a user
delete.description: Removes a role from a user. Admin and superadmin only.

post.summary: Add a permission to a role
post.description: Attaches a permission to a role. Superadmin only.

delete.summary: Remove a permission from a role
delete.description: Detaches a permission from a role. Superadmin only.

get.summary: Get a session by game pin
get.description: Returns session details including QR code and participants list. The host of the session can access this endpoint.
Returns the list of participants for a session. Used for polling in the lobby.

post.description: Creates a new game session for a quiz. Generates a unique 8-digit game pin and a QR code for players to join. The authenticated user becomes the host. Requires teacher, admin, or superadmin role.

quiz_id.description: The UUID of the quiz to create a game session for

message.example: You must be a teacher or admin to create a game session.
The quiz id field is required.

items.example: The quiz id field is required.

post.summary: Join a game session by game pin
post.description: Join an existing game session using an 8-digit game pin. The authenticated user's display name is used as the participant nickname.

error.example: Kein Spiel mit diesem Code gefunden.
Dieses Spiel hat bereits begonnen oder ist beendet.

post.description: Starts the game session, creating session questions and opening the first question. Only the host can start the game.
Closes the current question and opens the next one. If no more questions, finishes the game.

200.description: Advanced to next question or finished

get.description: Returns the current question with answer options (without correct answers) and timing information.

post.description: Closes the current question without advancing to the next one. Only the host can close a question.
Submit an answer for the current question. The answer must be submitted before the time limit expires.

get.description: Returns the current session status, question index, and whether a question is currently open. Used for polling.
Returns the answer distribution for the current question. Teacher-facing endpoint.
Returns participants ranked by total score.

get.summary: Get student review of all questions
get.description: Returns all questions in the session with the correct answers and the authenticated student's chosen answers, along with scoring details.

200.description: Student review with all questions and answers

get.summary: Get full review with all students' answers
get.description: Returns all questions with correct answers and every student's chosen answers. Teacher-facing endpoint.

200.description: Full review with all students and answers

get.description: Returns the final game results including leaderboard and quiz metadata.
Returns a participant-centric session report with per-student statistics including accuracy percentage, average response time, and detailed per-question answers.

patch.description: Allows the session host to override the AI evaluation of a free-text answer, marking it as correct or incorrect.

get.description: Returns a paginated, filterable list of users. Accessible by teachers, admins and superadmins.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Filter by role name (student, teacher, admin, superadmin)

parameters.name: class_prefix
parameters.description: Filter classes starting with this prefix (e.g. "3" matches 3a, 3b)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive search in email, username, display_name

post.description: Creates a new user and assigns a role. Admin and superadmin only.

password.description: Required when auth_provider is local. Must contain uppercase, lowercase and a number.

get.description: Returns distinct class names with the number of students in each. Accessible by teachers, admins and superadmins.
Returns aggregated user counts. Admin and superadmin only.

post.description: Imports multiple users at once. Skips existing emails and collects per-row errors. Admin and superadmin only.

get.description: Returns full user details. Admins and superadmins can view any user; other users can only view their own profile.

put.description: Updates user fields. Admins/superadmins can update all fields including role. Users can only update their own display_name and username. Setting is_active to false invalidates all active sessions.

role.description: Admin only — replaces all current roles with this one

delete.description: Soft-deletes a user. Superadmin only. Cannot delete yourself or the last superadmin.

422.description: Cannot delete yourself or last superadmin

post.description: Restores a previously soft-deleted user. Superadmin only.

patch.description: Changes the password for a local-auth user. Users changing their own password must supply current_password. Admins/superadmins resetting another user's password do not need current_password. Invalidates all active Sanctum tokens after a successful change.

new_password.description: Must contain uppercase, lowercase and a number

422.description: Wrong current password or non-local provider

get.description: Returns the number of quizzes the user has completed.
Returns the correct/wrong/unanswered answer distribution and correct percentage across all completed quizzes.
Returns a paginated list of completed quizzes with per-quiz breakdown of questions, correct/wrong answers, score, and completion time.
Returns the authenticated user's personal preferences (theme, language, font size).

put.description: Updates the authenticated user's personal preferences. Only provided fields are updated, others are preserved.

title.example: What is the capital of France?
